title: 初级汉语口语入门 (Introduction to Elementary Spoken Chinese)
provider: Beijing Language and Culture University / UMOOCs
language_notes: The official learner page is Chinese-language and does not explicitly identify a separate explanation language; the course is designed for zero-beginner Chinese learners.
reason: Current free 18-week BLCU beginner Mandarin course with 32 videos, 10 assessments and 32 downloadable resources covering pinyin and practical spoken communication for daily life and travel.
notes: The active 15th run is scheduled for 2026-08-24 through 2026-12-27. No free completion credential was confirmed on the public page.

title: Mandarin Chinese Level 1
reason: Self-paced six-week beginner Mandarin pathway whose provider page explicitly states that MandarinX courses can be audited for free, covering tones, everyday vocabulary and practical communication.
notes: Verified-track certification and some enrichment such as pronunciation lessons/webinars are paid; the free audit route is therefore conservatively F2 pending deep comparison.

title: Arabic Grammar Course
language_notes: The course teaches Modern Standard Arabic with English explanations; some examples and terminology also reference Classical/Qur'anic Arabic.
reason: Free long-form Arabic course with more than 90 grammar and morphology lessons, audio-supported examples and interactive exercises, backed by a separate free reading prerequisite for learners who do not yet know the Arabic script.
notes: Its strength is grammar, morphology and reading rather than balanced four-skill communicative coverage; deep review must assess transferability and pedagogical framing.

title: General Language learning pathway
language_notes: Arabic is the target and core lesson language; the site provides selectable mediator-language support for learners.
reason: Officially described as a free open educational resource, with a levelled General Language pathway from introductory through proficiency, interactive exercises with results, Arabic alphabet/sound sequences, daily-life lessons and placement testing.
notes: This is a structured open-learning pathway rather than a fixed cohort course. Paid Al Jazeera Media Institute courses are separate and must not be conflated with this free site.
